items.description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co

All your computers and your phone/iPhone, working as one desk. Screens, apps, files, clipboard, calls, texts, notifications, mouse and keyboard, shared between Mac, Windows, Linux , Android, Web and ios / ipados . Free and open source. No account, no cloud, and no shared network needed.
Fast, free voice assistant for your Mac. No API key. Remembers you and learns your shortcuts. Hold ⌃⌥Space and talk.
Coco Super Intelligence: agent skills, slash commands and subagents for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. One command installs them into the tool you already use.
Ever® Teams™ - The Workplace for Humans. Open Work & Productivity Platform - https://ever.team
Claude Code for professionals who don't code — Skills, agents, and setup guides
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.

Open-source Arc-style browser built on Chromium: sidebar with vertical tabs, Spaces, folders, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click import from Arc. macOS and Windows (Linux is coming soon). No telemetry.
The control plane for your AI employees
浮屿：Windows 和 macOS 上的轻量灵动岛。在屏幕顶部汇总 QQ、微信和邮件通知，查看 Claude Code / Codex 的运行状态并直接在岛上审批，还有剪贴板历史、快捷翻译、音乐与歌词、待办、日历和文件中转，支持插件扩展。
A fast, native scrollable-tiling window manager for macOS, inspired by Niri.
An open-source clipboard manager for Windows and macOS, with searchable history for text, images, links, colors, and files
Note taking and organization; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft OneNote, rebuilt in pure Rust

Free, open-source Grammarly alternative for Chrome & Safari — AI grammar checker and text rewriter for any website, powered by your own free Google Gemini API key. No account, no tracking, no subscription.

Claude Code on your laptop and remote dev boxes, in one web page. Sessions keep running when SSH drops (no tmux), each session's changes get their own diff, plus tasks, notes, and memory. Self-hosted.
